descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Paint Penthouse gives you a glass-walled penthouse high above a sunset city, two long blank walls, and a table full of real painting tools.

THE TOOLS
Spray guns and the spray can lay down soft clouds of colour when you pull the trigger. The airless sprayer covers a wall in seconds. Rollers put down solid, even coats, and brushes pick out the detail wherever they touch the wall.

THE COLOUR WHEEL
Press X and a wheel of 44 colours opens in front of you. Point the laser, pull the trigger, and your tools are loaded with that colour. Or dip a roller in the paint can, the bucket or the tray, or touch a brush to a chip on the colour fan deck.

THE PENTHOUSE
A floor-to-ceiling window looks out over a city of towers, with race pods, drones and a sky liner flying past. Walk through the sliding glass doors onto the balcony, relax in the lounge in front of the big TV, and change the sky from the remote by the glass: sunset, daylight, dawn, emerald or neon dusk.

START AGAIN ANY TIME
Tap the red reset post with any tool and every wall is wiped clean.

FEATURES
- Spray guns, an airless sprayer, a spray can, rollers and brushes
- A 44-colour wheel picked with a laser, plus a fan deck and dip pots
- Two huge paintable walls in a penthouse above the city
- A balcony with sliding glass doors and five skies to switch between
- Background music with its own menu
- Walk with the left stick, snap turn with the right
